## [1.7.0](https://github.com/jkennethcarino/adobo/compare/v1.6.0...v1.7.0) (2026-10-25)

### Bug Fixes

* **Reddit - Disable bottom navigation bar auto-hide:** Fix support for `2026.24.0` ([0369592](https://github.com/jkennethcarino/adobo/commit/036959297bce039aa16decdf815d18678e302d68))

### Features

* **Reddit:** Add `Hide related posts` patch ([0fb5d42](https://github.com/jkennethcarino/adobo/commit/0fb5d42816fd1fba509708d50e41cf86e022c0bf))
* **Reddit:** Add `Hide search answers preview` patch ([5a2193a](https://github.com/jkennethcarino/adobo/commit/5a2193a88241db975f4eef7ed75ae8c4344bece3))
* Update Morphe Patcher to 2.0 ([d21b91e](https://github.com/jkennethcarino/adobo/commit/d21b91e42c5d527414731a32df77c71ef643d6fc))

### Updated App Support

* **9GAG:** Add support for `8.24.8`, `8.25.1`, and `8.26.1` ([6e90bfd](https://github.com/jkennethcarino/adobo/commit/6e90bfd5058598a14f36b9d34b5bd19cfe0d7ec1))
* **Reddit:** Add support for `2026.43.0` ([f828cc8](https://github.com/jkennethcarino/adobo/commit/f828cc8d17efc6d8ae42d50e457e76a1a5c49331))

patches.name: Always-incognito mode
patches.description: Always opens Gboard in incognito mode to disable typing history collection and personalization.

patches.name: Enable OCR feature
patches.description: Enables the Scan Text feature to extract text from images and insert them into text fields.

patches.name: Enable Undo feature
patches.description: Enables the undo feature to quickly undo or correct typing mistakes.

patches.name: Enable access points menu redesign
patches.description: Enables the redesign of the additional actions menu.

patches.name: Enable clipboard in incognito
patches.description: Enables clipboard support in incognito mode.

patches.name: Enable extended clipboard history
patches.description: Enables extending the clipboard history expiration time.

patches.name: Enable key shape selection
patches.description: Enables an option to select a key shape from the theme.

patches.name: Enable voice typing in incognito
patches.description: Enables voice typing in incognito mode.

patches.name: Toggle feature flags
patches.description: Toggles Gboard feature flags to enable or disable experimental or hidden features.

options.description: The Gboard feature flags to toggle, such as experimental or hidden features.
Enables or disables all specified feature flags.

patches.name: Remove IMDb's ads, trackers, and analytics
patches.description: Removes ads, trackers, and analytics in the IMDb app.

patches.name: Disable forced update dialog
patches.description: Disables the forced update dialog on an outdated app version.

patches.name: Remove 9GAG's ads, trackers, and analytics
patches.description: Removes ads, trackers, and analytics in the 9GAG app.

patches.name: Sanitize share links
patches.description: Removes the tracking query parameters from shared links.

patches.name: Colorize comment indent lines
patches.description: Replaces the default gray comment indent lines with color-coded lines.

options.description: The hex color (#RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB) for comment indent line at depth 1.
The hex color (#RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB) for comment indent line at depth 2.
The hex color (#RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB) for comment indent line at depth 3.
The hex color (#RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB) for comment indent line at depth 4.
The hex color (#RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB) for comment indent line at depth 5.
The hex color (#RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB) for comment indent line at depth 6.
The hex color (#RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB) for comment indent line at depth 7.
The hex color (#RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB) for comment indent line at depth 8.

patches.name: Disable bottom navigation bar auto-hide
patches.description: Prevents the bottom navigation bar from hiding when scrolling down.

patches.name: Disable home feed auto-refresh
patches.description: Disables the automatic refresh of the home feed after viewing a post or after being away from the app.

patches.name: Disable home feed refresh on back to exit
patches.description: Disables the back-to-top scroll and home feed refresh on back navigation to exit.

patches.name: Disable home feed swipe
patches.description: Disables the horizontal page swipe gesture used to switch feeds.

patches.name: Disable home screen redirect
patches.description: Disables the automatic redirect to the home screen after being away from the app or returning from the background.

patches.name: Disable post detail swipe
patches.description: Disables the horizontal swipe gesture used to navigate between posts.

patches.name: Disable screenshot banner
patches.description: Disables the banner that shows up after taking a screenshot.

patches.name: Enable guest mode
patches.description: Enables browsing Reddit without signing in.

patches.name: Hide Ask button from search bar
patches.description: Hides the Ask button (Reddit Answers) from the search bar.

patches.name: Hide awards
patches.description: Hides the awards on Reddit posts and comments.

patches.name: Hide community highlights
patches.description: Hides the community highlights section.

patches.name: Hide community menu badge
patches.description: Hides the red notification badge on the community menu (hamburger menu).

patches.name: Hide crosspost
patches.description: Hides the crosspost on Reddit posts.

patches.name: Hide post view counts
patches.description: Removes the "views" indicator from the post metadata.

patches.name: Hide prominent search bar
patches.description: Hides the new prominent search bar on the main screen. Applicable only to version 2026.24.0 and earlier.

patches.name: Hide related posts
patches.description: Hides the related posts section displayed at the bottom of a post.

patches.name: Hide search answers preview
patches.description: Hides the Reddit Answers preview section at the top of search results.

patches.name: Hide share count
patches.description: Hides the share count on Reddit posts.

patches.name: Hide upvote scores
patches.description: Hides the scores on Reddit posts and comments.

options.description: Removes scores from posts in feeds and search results.
Removes scores from comments in threads and search results.

patches.name: Hide user community badges
patches.description: Hides the user community badges on Reddit comments.

patches.name: Hide user flairs
patches.description: Hides the user flairs on Reddit comments.

patches.name: Make system navigation bar transparent
patches.description: Sets the system navigation bar to fully transparent.

patches.name: Open external links directly
patches.description: Opens external links directly without going through out.reddit.com.

patches.name: Remove ads and telemetry
patches.description: Removes ads and telemetry everywhere.

patches.name: Sanitize share links
patches.description: Unshortens and removes the tracking query parameters from shared links.
